message.content: {"summary": "严重度为高或严重时现象必填（规则草稿），并在现象字段加填写说明", "ops": [{"op": "addRule", "rule": {"code": "symptomRequiredWhenSevere", "level": "L1", "when": "$model.severity == 'HIGH' || $model.severity == 'CRITICAL'", "assert": "has($model.symptom) && $model.symptom != null && size($model.symptom) > 0", "field": "symptom", "message": "严重度为高或严重时，必须填写现象"}}, {"op": "updateField", "key": "symptom", "set": {"help": "严重度为高或严重时必填"}}]}
